svg.title: A proper sector of perimeter eighteen has an interior area maximum
svg.desc: For a proper sector with angle strictly between zero and two pi radians and perimeter eighteen centimetres, theta equals eighteen over r minus two. Thus r is strictly between nine over pi plus one and nine. Area is nine r minus r squared, or eighty-one quarters minus r minus nine halves squared. The feasible maximum area is eighty-one quarters square centimetres at radius nine halves centimetres and angle two radians. The diagram shows that sector with arc length nine centimetres. The area graph uses hollow markers for the excluded limiting sectors; dashed grey is outside the physical domain.
